calculation.description: Cross-sectionally demean daily log returns, identify persistent relative losers over 60 sessions, scale by residual volatility, and invert to favor subsequent 10-day rebounds. Inputs are lagged one completed session.

parameters.residual_definition: daily log return minus cross-sectional mean

validation.regime_notes: Positive across the full available validation sample; regime IC/ICIR: 2024-2026 0.19029/0.67133 (106 dates), 2027-2029 0.02376/0.08579 (782), 2030-2032 0.08566/0.32471 (747). Small 15-asset universe requires conservative interpretation.
validation.artifact_transform: signal is the directly computed contrarian factor
